description:
Earlier this week, Ubisoft announced sweeping changes to the video game publisher, including the cancelation of seven games. The only confirmed title from that group was the remake of Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time. However, a new report indicates that the long-gestating Beyond Good and Evil 2 was not among the games that were purged.

According to Insider Gaming, "Beyond Good and Evil 2 is still in active development, at least for the time being." The original Beyond Good and Evil was released i
title: Beyond Good And Evil 2 Is Still In Development After Ubisoft's Purge - Report

description:
Until this year, Elena was the only character introduced in Street Fighter 3 to be playable in Street Fighter 6. However, Alex's turn is coming soon, and he's the subject of the latest Street Fighter 6 gameplay trailer from Capcom.

AEW fans may have noticed that Alex has adopted some of his pro wrestling moves from Kenny Omega, who performed motion capture for the game. More specifically, Alex is unleashing the V-Trigger knee strike and the One-Winged Angel finishing maneuver. He also seems to favor getting close to his opponents before mercilessly beating them in front of the crowd.

Alex is the third DLC character from Street Fighter 6 Year 3, following the release of Sagat and C. Viper in 2025. Last year, Omega starred in the reveal trailer for this group and
title: Street Fighter 6 Unleashes Alex's Power Moves In New Gameplay Trailer

description:
Last year, Animal Crossing fans in Australia and New Zealand were able to experience an aquarium tour sponsored by Nintendo and Sea Life. Next month, that tour is finally coming to the US with stops across America through the rest of this year.

Unlike the previous tour, there will be overlapping Animal Crossing events at multiple Sea Life aquariums. Each location will feature photo ops for fans to appear alongside Animal Crossing: New Horizons' characters in aquatic-themed backgrounds. Fans can also pose alongside standees of Animal Crossing characters, including Kapp'n.

The tours will have educational material about the real-lif
title: Animal Crossing Aquarium Tour Is Coming To The US This Year
Persona 3 Reload Switch 2 Edition Is Down To $40

description:
If you're curious about Bungie's new shooter Marathon and worried about plunking down $40, Bungie has some welcome news. There will be an "open preview weekend" for the game ahead of launch.

Bungie confirmed this on social media, writing, "We'll have an open preview weekend before launch, and everyone will be able to try Marathon out." The wording here suggests this will be free.

Marathon has endured multiple controversies already, with Bungie settling a case after art plagiarism allegations, while the studio has also faced questions about whether
title: Marathon Will Have A Free Test For Everyone Before Launch

description:
Before Battlefield 6 Season 2 was pushed back to February 17, the season would have begun today, January 21. While Battlefield 6 players are still waiting to learn what's coming in the new season, a leak on Reddit has revealed that one of the maps is Hagental Airbase in Bravia.

In the leaked trailer, NATO forces have lost control of Hagental Airbase, and the voiceover warns that they need to take it back or the momentum of the war will go against them. Some fans on Reddit have complained about the apparent size of the map, and that the airbase doesn't appear to allow jets in battle.

Separately, Battlefield 6's social channels revealed Contaminated, a new map for the
title: New Battlefield 6 Season 2 Map Revealed

description:
The God of War TV series continues to add to its cast, with a new report stating that Max Parker has joined the show to play Heimdall.

Deadline reported the news, though Prime Video has not confirmed the casting. He would be the third actor set to appear in the show, following Ryan Hurst as Kratos and Teresa Palmer as Phoebe/Sif.

Parker is known for his role on the longrunning soap Emmerdale Farm and the Netflix series Boots, which was recently canceled.

Continue Reading at GameSpot
title: God Of War TV Show Finds Its Heimdall Actor

description:
The Super Mario Galaxy Movie hasn't revealed all of its secrets just yet. Mario voice actor Chris Pratt has teased that, while trailers so far have featured characters not seen in the first movie like Rosalina and Bowser Jr., fans still haven't seen every character who will be in the sequel.

Pratt told GamesRadar that there are multiple new characters who weren't in the 2023 movie that he's excited to see in the next movie. "I'm not allowed to say what they are, but yes, there are some really incredible ... Well, I think some of them have been released in the trailer--Rosalina, Bowser Jr.--and then there's even a couple more that are not in the trailer that people should be excited to see," Pratt said.
title: Super Mario Galaxy Movie's Chris Pratt Says Trailers So Far Haven't Shown All The Characters

description:
The Xbox PC app, and a majority of Xbox Game Pass PC titles, will now work on Arm-based Windows 11 PCs, Microsoft has announced.

The news comes as part of a blog detailing various updates across the Xbox ecosystem this month. Recent improvements like changes to the Prism emulator that runs x86/x64 software on Arm devices to support AVX and AVX2, as well as Epic Anti-Cheat support, means more modern games are now capable of running on Arm-based Windows PC devices, according to Microsoft.

While not all games will work, Xbox states more than 85% of titles available on Game Pass will, and that it is working with partners to further expand that number. Games that are not yet supported to run locally can still be p
title: Xbox January Update Includes Easier Game-Save Syncs And Arm-PC Support

description:
We now know which games will leave PlayStation Plus Premium and Extra's Game Catalog in February. The biggest highlights include Cult of the Lamb and New World: Aeternum.

If you go to the Collections tab of your PS4 or PS5's PS Plus menu, you'll see that the following seven games are confirmed to be leaving PS Plus:

  • Cult of the Lamb
  • New World Aeternum
  • Rez Infinite
  • SaGa Frontier Remastered
  • Super Neptunia RPG
  • The Ascent
  • WWE 2K25

While the individual PlayStation Store pages for each game don't yet show the date and time these games will no longer be available through this subscription service, they are expected to be removed around 12 PM ET on February 17. This will align with when the next s
title: New World, Cult of the Lamb Will Leave The PS Plus Extra Catalog In February

description:
Game developer Innersloth announced in 2023 that it was working with Hollywood people to make an Among Us TV show. Not much has said been said about the series in the time since, prompting some to theorize that the show may be in trouble as is known to happen in Hollywood.

As part of Innersloth's 2026 roadmap, the developer said, "It's not dead okay, don't worry."

That's all the studio had to say on the matter, so it is not much to go on. However, the assurance that the show remains in the works is something.

Continue Reading at GameSpot
title: Among Us TV Show Gets A Critical Production Update That Should Make Fans Happy

description:
Preorders for Bungie's new shooter Marathon went live this week, but things did not go entirely to plan for the PC version on Steam. People reported that upon preordering Marathon on Steam, they also got Destiny 2 automatically installed without any prompting.

This was an issue that Bungie has now fixed, the developer said. Additionally, Bungie said it fixed an issue with the Collector's Edition that caused players to get an error when trying to activate game codes on Steam.

People who buy Marathon before release get free cosmetics for Destiny 2, and some theorized this could be related to the issue. However, Bungie did not explain why or how t
title: Marathon Preorders Included A Forced Destiny 2 Download, But It's Fixed Now

description:
New World of Warcraft user-interface additions like its built-in damage meter aren't intended to offer all the bells and whistles that player-made mods (aka add-ons) provide, Blizzard has said in a new interview.

The pre-patch for the upcoming Midnight expansion went live January 20, and with it came major additions to WoW's base user interface that are meant to provide some of the core utility Blizzard once relied on add-ons to provide, as well as changes to what add-ons are allowed to do when it comes to aiding in combat.
title: WoW's New Damage Meter Is, By Design, Worse Than What Add-Ons Can Offer
You Can Bundle Disney+ And Hulu For $10 For Your First Month

description:
Peak will get a new biome in 2026, according to co-developer Aggro Crab. The new segment of the climb will replace the game’s existing Caldera area, though players shouldn’t expect it anytime soon. The biome is planned as a later update and is still early enough that the studio isn’t ready to share specifics about what it will look like or how it will play.

The Caldera replacement is part of a broader plan to slow Peak’s update cadence in 2026. Aggro Crab confirmed that there are still a couple of updates in development that focus on commonly requested features from players, but those updates will roll out less frequently than in the past. The studio declined to detail what those features are, saying it wants to talk about them closer to release.
title: Peak's Final Biome Will Replace Caldera, But Not Soon

description:
In addition to a collaboration with Fortnite, South Park is heading to another popular Epic Games title. The developer has announced that Rocket League is getting a South Park crossover as well in the form of an event called "Cartman's Crash Out."

As part of this, Cartman, Stan, Kyle, Kenny, and Butters are coming to Rocket League on January 22. Players can complete challenges in the event, which runs through February 5, to unlock toppers based on them.
title: Rocket League Collab With South Park Goes Live This Week, Adds All These New Toppers

description:
The early access launch of Hytale has been a huge success, with over a million players hopping in and exploring the new sandbox title. This is especially impressive given that Hytale is only available on PC, preventing players on consoles from trying out the Minecraft clone. However, you can bring the experience of a console to Hytale if you don't want to use a mouse and keyboard when playing on PC.

Below, you can see a workaround that allows you to plug in and successfully use a controller in Hytale.

Playing Hytale with a controller

Currently, there are a few workarounds you can use to get a controller to work when playing Hytale, and if you're not ready to use Hytale mods, don't worry. You don't need to mod the game to play it on controller. You have to be careful when following the steps, though, as they're easy to mess up and only h
title: How To Play Hytale With A Controller

description:
After a prolonged development period, Ubisoft hit the brakes on the remake of Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time. But in the wake of the disappointing news, the publisher said that it isn't calling it quits on the long-running franchise.

The remake was canceled as the project wasn't able to "reach the level of quality" expected from fans, according to a statement from the Prince of Persia development team on X. The statement added that the team didn't want to "release something short of what The Sands of Time represents."

The statement goes on to read: "Prince of Persia as a universe and a legacy continues to matter deeply to us, and this decision does not mean we're stepping away from the franchise."
title: The Prince Of Persia Series Will Continue Despite The Sands Of Time Remake Cancellation

description:
The Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time remake has been officially canceled, Ubisoft has confirmed. It's not the only casualty of the company's "major organisational, operational and portfolio reset": Six more games have been canceled, seven projects have been delayed, two Ubisoft studios will be shut down, and layoffs across the board are on the way.

pic.twitter.com/6Rv5CqZtQD

— Prince of Persia™ (@princeofpersia) January 21, 2026

In a press release, Ubisoft has said that this "major reset" is part of a shift in its strategy to focus on live-service and
title: Prince Of Persia: The Sands Of Time Remake Canceled As Ubisoft Axes And Delays Multiple Projects

description: Lucy and Kurt Talk about the game's they are excited for in 2026 Watch the full Kurt & Lucy Gotcha Covered Episode: https://youtu.be/5b3BQeKPes4
title: One of the Best Horror Games is BACK this Year

description:
The New York Times' games are filled with single-player experiences, but now the news organization is launching its first two-player game as a standalone app. Starting today, NYT is inviting readers to try Crossplay, a game that should seem very familiar to anyone who has tried Words with Friends or Scrabble.

Crossplay is now live, and this is how it works: Players start each game with seven letters on the same board. The object is to score points from creating words or playing off of the words that are already on the board. More points are awarded depending upon the rarity of the letter and where it's placed on a the board.

Each player has a limited number of tile bags that are lost after a tile is played on the board. Once players run out of tiles, Crossplay enters one final round to give both players one last chance to succeed.
title: New York Times Releases Its First Multiplayer Word Game, Crossplay

description:
The latest Battlefield 6 community update details some of the new content planned for Season 2, including a brand-new multiplayer map called Contaminated. The developer also teased the return of a classic Battlefield 4 map, and it gave an update on the likelihood of a solo playlist for Redsec battle royale.

As previously announced, Battlefield 6's Season 2 update has been delayed, and Battlefield Studios is currently using the extra time to develop and refine the upcoming seasonal content. The new community update reveals Battlefield Labs is being used to test on one of Season 2's new maps called Contaminated. The studio says it is using the map to evaluate how vehicle gameplay and aerial presence interact with infantry combat, alongside cover and asset
title: Battlefield 6 Community Update Reveals Season 2 Plans And Testing For Solo BR

description:
If you tuned into Geoff Keighley's TGA ceremony in December last year, you might recall how odd it seemed to have the show end with Highguard, a new free-to-play, hero-based shooter from former Titanfall 2 and Apex Legends developers. What you might not remember is that Highguard is out in just a couple of days, with not much to show for it.

That might have initially indicated that the shooter was primed for a delay, but subtle changes to the game's listing on Steam paint a different picture. Updates to the listing have been occurring since the game's reveal, but a few over the past two days certainly make it seem like Highguard has no intention to miss its January 26 release date. In just the last 24 hours, developer Wildlight Entertainment has made
title: Highguard, The Confusing TGA Closer, Shows Life Ahead Of Launch Next Week

description:
On January 22, the fourth-ever Xbox Developer Direct showcase will take place. Right now, we know that it will feature Game Freak's Beast of Reincarnation as well as Forza Horizon 6 and Fable from Playground Games. If this year's Developer Direct follows in the footsteps of every previous incarnation of the show, there's likely to be an unexpected surprise, as well.

Most famously, Hi-Fi Rush was shadow-dropped during the first Developer Direct, making for one of the most exhilarating moments of the console generation for Xbox players. Moments of hope like that are few and far between for Xbox fans nowadays. As Xbox's future looks more mysterious than ever in 2026, this year's Developer Direct would really benefit by delivering
title: Xbox Developer Direct's "One More Thing" Matters More Than Ever In 2026

description:
The benefit of Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas being as old as they are is the robust modding scene that has been built around them, giving you new ways to enjoy both classic role-playing games. It's an area where any imminent remasters will likely fall short, and that's for certain already if you're hoping for support from one of the series' most popular mods.

Tale of Two Wastelands might be the most comprehensive and popular mod for both Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas, seamlessly combining the two experiences into one massive, cohesive adventure across its two distinct open worlds. The mod brings the quality-of-life and gameplay updates in New Vegas and introduces them to Fallout 3, while giving you the ability to use a single character across both adventures, complete with balancing changes and enhancements to support both campaigns. Switching between
title: One Of Fallout's Most Popular Mods Won't Support Rumored Remasters

description:
The newly announced Life is Strange: Reunion will not feature Ashly Burch as the voice of Chloe. Burch voiced Chloe--one of the franchise's main characters--in the first game in 2015.

She did not come back for most of Life is Strange: Before the Storm due to the video game voice actor strike. Rhianna DeVries voiced Chloe in that game, and will voice her again in Reunion. Burch did, however, return to voice Chloe for Before the Storm's bonus episode, Farewell.
title: Life Is Strange: Reunion Won't Bring Back Original Chloe Voice Actor

description:
Bethesda has delivered a chunky new update for Fallout 76 that's mainly focused on fixing issues in the online RPG. One fun specific gameplay area that's addressed relates to player Ghoul characters, who now must wear a disguise to re-enter Fort Atlas and Crater Core. The patch notes highlight that the download size isn't small: It's 28.9GB on Xbox, 12.8GB on PlayStation, 14.7GB on Steam, and 26.7GB on the PC Microsoft Store.

This is the first major patch for Fallout 76 since the Burning Springs update went live last month. Burning Springs brings players to a wasteland version of Ohio, with new creatures to encounter as well as The Ghoul from the Prime TV show. Yes, Walton Goggins reprises his role,
title: New Fallout 76 Update Is All About Squashing Bugs, And We're Not Talking Radroaches

description:
Over the last couple of years, Epic Games has made a big push into Hollywood with its Unreal Engine software. Best known as a game development engine, recent upgrades have made it a powerful tool for film and television, as seen in productions like The Mandalorian. While it has its fans, Pirates of the Caribbean director Gore Verbinski isn't one of them, likening the rise of Unreal Engine 5 in Hollywood to the "greatest slip backwards" for the moviemaking industry, resulting in films that look too much like video games.

"It used to be a divide, with Unreal Engine being very good at video games, but then people started thinking maybe movies can also use Unreal for finished visual effects," Verbinski said to But Why Tho (via VGC
title: Unreal Engine Makes Films Look Too Much Like Games, Pirates Of The Caribbean Director Says

description:
Prime Video recently announced that Sons of Anarchy actor Ryan Hurst will play Kratos in the upcoming live-action TV series. Christopher Judge, who portrayed Kratos in 2018's God of War and 2022's God of War Ragnarok, has now reacted to the casting, saying Hurst is a "magnificent choice."

"All I wanted for whoever was cast as Kratos was that they love, cherish, and respect Kratos as much as we all do," Judge said at Fan Expo in New Orleans. "And with Ryan Hurst, they have done that. It's a magnificent choice, not only a great actor but a great person. And a gamer who actually played God of War since its inception. So, kudos, you've got a great live-action Kratos."
title: Kratos Video Game Actor Reacts To Casting Of Someone Else For The TV Show

description:
Nintendo doesn't seem to have a sensible strategy or pattern when it comes to updating old Switch games for the new Switch 2, with the latest title getting a refresh being last year's Donkey Kong Country Returns HD. The new (and free) update for the platformer adds new features for players on both Switch and Switch 2, with the most exciting being the addition of a fan-favorite character.

Dixie Kong joins the vine-swinging platforming adventure, retaining her ponytail helicopter move from Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze. As in that game, she'll ride DK's back and provide an extremely useful hover, and a second player can separately control her in co-op.

The update also adds a Turbo Attack mode, which amps up the game's speed for frantic time trials. Players on Switch 2 will also see improved resolution, faster loading times, and GameShare support.
title: Donkey Kong Country Returns HD Gets Dixie Kong And Switch 2 Enhancements In Free Update

description:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 has "ruined" the world view of game developer Adrian Chmielarz, a gaming veteran who has been working in the business for decades. The People Can Fly co-founder who now heads up Witchfire studio The Astronauts said in an interview that the fact that Expedition 33 was developed by a core team of "newbies" is making him rethink his own work processes.

He told GI.biz, "There is this old saying that 10 professional soldiers are as effective as a hundred amateurs, or even a thousand, and that's quite simply true. So when you have a small team, it's really important that you have the best people."

He said he recently learned that Sandfall "hired a lot of newbies--people who didn't make a game before" when crafting Expedition 33. "And now my world view is ruined, and I don't know what t
title: Why Expedition 33 "Ruined" This Industry Veteran's Views On Gaming

description:
There have been rumors for years about Fortnite getting both a basketball mode and, separately, a proper Fall Guys integration. Now, both of those things are happening at the same time, with Fall Guys Crown Jam, a new limited-time mode in which you play 3v3 basketball as a bean person.

In Fall Guys Crown Jam, which is available starting January 23 and runs through February 9, you and your teammates will fight to score across an obstacle-filled basketball court--it looks pretty much as though Mediatonic designed a new game for Fall Guys, and then Epic liked it so much they decided to make it a separate thing. See it in action in the trailer below.
title: Fortnite Is Getting Fall Guys Basketball on Friday

description:
Developer Sandfall Interactive's Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 was one of 2025's biggest breakout hits, reaching more than 5 million in sales and winning multiple Game of the Year awards. Expedition 33 is in the news yet again this week, but it's not what you think.

NASA has announced that veteran astronaut Suni Williams retired on December 27, 2025, after more than 27 years with the space agency. Williams is known for a long list of impressive accomplishments in the space frontier, including her role as Space Station Commander for Expedition 33. On this mission, Williams performed three spacewalks, including time outside the station to repair a radiator leak and to replace power components.

Williams is also known for launching on Boeing's Starliner spacecraft in June 20
title: Expedition 33 Is In The News Again But I Guarantee It's Not For The Reason You Think

description:
Hades and Hades 2 are beloved for many reasons--they're top-tier action roguelikes with incredible combat and smart progression systems that look and sound amazing--but one of the most enduring elements of both games is their storytelling. The writers at developer Supergiant Games have nailed the unique tone of the Greek pantheon and all its bitter rivalries, tragic loves and petty squabbles, and fans of the series might be looking for other works with similar vibes.

Another popular exploration of Greek myth is Rachel Smythe's webcomic Lore Olympus, which focuses on, in the author's own words, "the friendships and the lies, the gossip and the wild parties, and of course, forbidden love" of the gods. And now,
title: Hades Fans Should Know About Amazon's Upcoming Sexy Greek God Animated Series

description: Everyone, remain calm. Deep breaths. We don’t wanna alarm anyone, but there have been quite a few signs lately that Valve may actually be making the fabled Half-Life 3 a reality. And we assure you, that’s not just galaxy-brain copium this time, and it’s not just some tiny morsel from a Half-Life 2 optimization update we’re working with here. Valve has been making moves the last few years, from the leaks of new information from the recently-added commentary tracks for Half-Life 2, to secret projects popping up on actors’ resumes that sound an awful lot like a job the One Free Man might do. But it’s when Valv
title: Half Life 3 Might Finally Be Happening - Here’s What We Know

description:
When you enter a house in Minecraft, you're often greeted with a large room that features chests, crafting stations, and other essentials for adventuring. However, what about beyond that initial room that most Minecraft houses have? Some players might already have a laundry list of room ideas that they can use to populate their house, but it can be difficult to come up with useful ideas that also have some functionality to them.

If you're struggling to design some extra rooms in your house or are just looking for more room ideas, you're in the right place. Today, we'll be listing five unique room ideas that you can use to spruce up your house in Minecraft so you're not just stuck with vanilla rooms that are filled with a dozen chests.


Cobblestone Generator
title: Best Minecraft Room Ideas

description:
Last summer, EA announced that Anthem would be shut down in January 2026, and the game's final playable date passed earlier this month. But some fans aren't ready to let go of the former live-service shooter. And one player has demonstrated that Anthem can still be played on a private server.

And799 posted a video on YouTube that showed off Anthem running after its shut-down date. And799 notes that this wasn't meant to be a revival project, and it was only intended for "my research and experiment." The video's description also states that it looks like "the majority of the player data [was] handled through BioWare's server instead of Blaze, and it is required for the game to be able to load offline."
title: Anthem Is Technically Still Playable, But You Probably Won't Be Able To

description:
Hytale may have only launched into early access mere days ago, but its first update has already been rolled out, and it's quite the big one. Hypixel, after reacquiring its game from Riot, has been hard at work listening to player feedback and implementing changes. For its first update, Hytale now has dinosaurs populating its underground jungles. While the developer states that the prehistoric mobs are a "work in progress," they seem pretty solid early iterations.

Hypixel says that these new NPCs required a "change to the environment in the biome," so if you're not finding any spawning near your base, try traveling to chunks farther away that you haven't explored just yet.

As well as dinosaurs, some of the biomes have had minor adjustments. The Devastated Lands sewers have atmospheric effects and creatures will spawn. Areas beneath volcanoes will use volcanic environmental effects. Feran villages have had entity placements, textures, and interiors fixed. Finally, an invi
title: New Hytale Update Adds Dinosaurs, New Sound Effects, Easier Storage Upgrades, And More

description:
After sweeping The Game Awards 2025 with a record-breaking number of both nominations and wins, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 has edged out Elden Ring to become the most Game Of The Year-awarded title of all time.

Expedition 33 has taken home a grand total of 436 GOTY titles, including major awards like The Game Awards GOTY as well as outlet-specific titles--including GameSpot's own Game of the Year--as tracked by users at Resetera. Elden Ring
title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Has Officially Passed Elden Ring For The Most GOTY Titles Of All Time

description:
Fortnite has so many different kinds of collaborations that it's rare for one to be particularly surprising, especially in the wake of that 28 Years Later spinal cord pickaxe that dropped last week. Even so, Fortnite's freshly-teased collaboration with The Office--a sitcom that's been off the air for more than a decade--feels like it qualifies.

The collab, which is for the US version of the series, had been rumored for a few weeks, but it was officially teased on Tuesday with a tweet that gave a Fortnite-themed twist on a famous line from the show.

Build. Beets. Battle Royale. pic.twitter.com/erCDcS0ZS
title: Fortnite X The Office Is Somehow Very Real

description:
From its vintage aesthetics and soundtrack to its captivating voice performances, Bethesda's Fallout series has unquestionably established itself as an iconic video game property. Now, with the television series from Prime, the post-apocalyptic adventure has firmly cemented itself as an iconic franchise, as week after week the series manages to capture all the elements that have delighted players throughout the years--especially the series' love of dishing out deep lore. Season two, episode six ups the ante on its deep cuts, offering plenty of lore and memorable moments of its own. Let’s break down some of the episode's easter eggs and biggest moments in this week’s episode of Fallout.

Ron Perlman
title: Fallout Episode 6 Just Introduced Super-Mutants (And Got An Iconic Movie Star To Play One)

description:
Last week’s episode saw us hit a boiling point between Lucy Maclean (Ella Purnell) and Cooper Howard (Walton Goggins)--one that resulted in him being power-fisted out a hotel window and impaled onto a pole below. Suffice to say, the stakes are getting high in season two of Fallout. Last we saw Lucy, she was knocked out and her father Hank (Kyle MacLachlan) was just arriving to pick her up. Meanwhile, Maximus (Aaron Moten) and Thaddeus’ (Johnny Pemberton) fates were left unknown in the aftermath of the chaos at Area 51. With the season reaching its most climatic point, let's break down the fallout (heh) of recent developments in this week’s episode.

The episode opens up with a pre-war flashback showing Barbara Howard (Frances Turner) performing her day-to-day duties at Vault-Tec in preparation of the incoming apocalypse. Among these duties is choosing the blast radius size for the Los Angeles area and receiving an important piece of news: turns out, Vault-Tec’s waterch
title: Fallout Episode 6 Just Set The Stage For Some Game-Changing Confrontations
